column1: # p324 — 2026-10-19 — tenth pass of this date. EVERY ROW MEASURED FIRST-HAND IN THIS PASS.
# INSTRUMENTS, and this pass changed two of them:
#   [API]  GitHub REST search via the MCP `search_repositories` tool. REACHABLE in this session,
#          where earlier cycles of this KB recorded the GitHub API as proxy-blocked. Source of
#          every stars/forks/pushed/archived/topics value below. `get_file_contents` is REFUSED
#          (session credentials are scoped to one repository), so it was not used.
#   [PAGE] The rendered github.com repository page through the fetch channel. Source of commit
#          counts, sidebar licence entries and README prose.
#   [RAW]  raw.githubusercontent.com via curl. Source of licence-file EXISTENCE and licence BODY.
# CHANNEL NOTES — both of these could have produced wrong rows and are recorded so a later pass
#   1. `curl` to github.com itself returns 403 through this session's proxy (repository roots and
#      blob/ paths alike). The task's prescribed `curl -sI` URL check CANNOT be run against
#      github.com here. A 403 is this session's binding, NOT a dead repository.
#      (a) the openeduhub ITS tier writes README.org, NOT README.md, so a Markdown-shaped probe
#          returns 404 on every repository in that org. A 404 is evidence of absence ONLY after
#          the filename space has been enumerated.
#      (b) through this proxy it served the same file for `main`, `master` AND `develop` on
#          repositories having only one of those branches, so the BRANCH component of a raw URL
#          is not a discriminator here — a raw read is a read of the default branch.
# LICENCE PROBE SPACE (the 7 names every "no licence" verdict below was taken over):
